objects.name: audit_events
objects.redacted_explanation: AI Gateway audit history is retained as redacted historical evidence; actor, invocation and request references are remapped and no event resumes execution.

objects.name: audit_logs
objects.redacted_explanation: Audit history is retained with redaction and actor mapping; backup-control audit cutoff is verified separately.

objects.name: chat_messages
objects.redacted_explanation: Chat content is confidential historical data. Restore remaps session, actor, instance and invocation references and never restores a live conversation cursor.

objects.name: chat_sessions
objects.redacted_explanation: Chat sessions are restored as historical session metadata with target user and instance mapping; session activity is not resumed automatically.

objects.name: cost_records
objects.redacted_explanation: Cost records are immutable accounting history; target identifiers are remapped and monetary/token aggregates are verified without replaying provider calls.

objects.name: egress_private_exceptions
objects.redacted_explanation: User and instance references require target mapping; destination policy must be revalidated.

objects.name: enterprise_auth_settings
objects.redacted_explanation: Enterprise authentication policy is retained with secret material represented only by typed refs; encrypted bind credentials never enter manifest, evidence or restored active state.

objects.name: instance_gateway_token_aliases
objects.redacted_explanation: Gateway token aliases contain only non-reversible token hashes and expiry history; restored rows cannot become active credentials without a new token issuance.

objects.name: instance_skills
objects.redacted_explanation: Use B's shared instance and workspace mapping; preserve removals and the original observed-content difference from the library package. Do not install or synchronize skills. Validate each version belongs to the same skill and each path stays under the isolated workspace root.

objects.name: llm_models
objects.redacted_explanation: Model catalog metadata is restored with provider and secret references redacted; API key material is never copied into a manifest or evidence.

objects.name: model_invocations
objects.redacted_explanation: Invocation history is immutable audit and usage data; request/response bodies are redacted under the AI policy and restored rows cannot trigger provider execution.

objects.name: northbound_admin_settings
objects.redacted_explanation: Authentication and instance-management settings require A and B review and target-side reference validation.

objects.name: northbound_auth_challenges
objects.redacted_explanation: Authentication challenges are retained only as expired or consumed history; nonce hashes and challenge state never restore as usable login material.

objects.name: northbound_caller_policies
objects.redacted_explanation: Caller scopes are restored only after user mapping and closed permission validation; the target cannot inherit an unrecognized or expanded scope.

objects.name: northbound_sessions
objects.redacted_explanation: Northbound sessions are restored as revoked historical records; refresh-token hashes and session state cannot be used to continue a source session.

objects.name: northbound_settings_audit
objects.redacted_explanation: Settings audit history is confidential and requires actor and target-setting reference verification.

objects.name: risk_hits
objects.redacted_explanation: Risk detections are retained as redacted historical findings with rule and invocation references remapped; they do not re-trigger enforcement on restore.

objects.name: risk_rules
objects.redacted_explanation: Risk policy is restored through the closed rule schema and normalized action set; unsupported or unsafe actions are rejected before activation.

objects.name: schema_migrations
objects.redacted_explanation: Only applied filenames and the catalog hash are referenced; source rows and DDL are never restored.

objects.name: security_scan_configs
objects.redacted_explanation: Scanner configuration is restored only after target analyzers and actor references are validated.

objects.name: security_scan_job_items
objects.redacted_explanation: Job and asset references require target mapping; nonterminal work is normalized to a non-running state.

objects.name: security_scan_jobs
objects.redacted_explanation: Historical scan jobs may contain sensitive findings and actor references; nonterminal state cannot resume implicitly.

objects.name: security_scan_reports
objects.redacted_explanation: Reports are confidential and remain valid only when their restored job and asset references verify.

objects.name: skill_blobs
objects.redacted_explanation: Map object locators to the isolated object target and retain source digest semantics. Compute independent streamed SHA-256 over captured bytes. A nonempty locator without content fails integrity; an empty locator requires reviewed B workspace recovery proof and is not silently accepted. No production fallback reads.

objects.name: skill_hub_tag_assignments
objects.redacted_explanation: Preserve exact skill/tag membership using the shared mapping. Reject missing endpoints and duplicate associations; never broaden publication or tag permissions.

objects.name: skill_hub_tags
objects.redacted_explanation: Preserve tag identity, key, order and admin_only restriction. Seeded tags must not be duplicated and administrator-only tags must not become publicly assignable.

objects.name: skill_package_materialize_jobs
objects.redacted_explanation: Preserve original rows in the encrypted backup. In the drill target, normalize pending/running to the existing cancelled state, preserve terminal history and timestamps, and map instance/skill/blob/workspace references. Never start backfill, claim or retry; unknown status fails normalization.

objects.name: skill_scan_results
objects.redacted_explanation: Preserve historical engine, risk, timestamps and blob references without treating them as fresh approval. Findings and summaries are encrypted payload only and redacted from evidence. Do not invoke the scanner or resume pending scan work.

objects.name: skill_versions
objects.redacted_explanation: Preserve every version and its skill/blob mapping, including versions not currently selected. Manifest bytes remain encrypted payload and never enter unredacted evidence. Restoring metadata must not create packages, versions or scan work.

objects.name: skills
objects.redacted_explanation: Preserve all skill versions, ownership, visibility and publication history through the shared identity map. Validate current-version ownership and scan-result references; never publish, install or scan during drill. Free text stays in encrypted payload only.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_artifact_lease_states
objects.redacted_explanation: The per-source lease mode and generation guard is target-local coordination metadata that makes shared and delete leases mutually exclusive without storing provider content.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_artifact_leases
objects.redacted_explanation: Artifact leases are target-local coordination facts with typed source and holder IDs; no provider locator, credential or restore inventory is persisted.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_admin_revocations
objects.redacted_explanation: Only schema metadata is recorded. Installation-local token revocation cutoffs are never dumped or restored from a source backup. Existing target cutoffs must not be cleared; a new target requires fresh authentication identities before admission.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_admin_sessions
objects.redacted_explanation: Only schema metadata is recorded. Live session digests, credential bindings, expirations and revocation flags are never dumped or restored. Current target sessions cannot be replaced with source sessions.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_alert_states
objects.redacted_explanation: Low-cardinality persisted alert sequences survive controller restarts but contain no resource public IDs, free labels or owner payloads.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_artifact_verifications
objects.redacted_explanation: Artifact verification rows retain task state, observed hashes and typed evidence references without embedding provider locations or verifier payloads.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_attempts
objects.redacted_explanation: Attempt history is a target-local execution ledger with typed task and phase references; runner jobs, check bodies and provider details are not restored.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_check_results
objects.redacted_explanation: The shared verifier envelope is target-local control metadata; owner-defined check registries and expected/actual payload schemas remain external and are never reconstructed from restored rows.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_compact_tombstones
objects.redacted_explanation: Compact tombstones preserve redacted idempotency and terminal hashes for control-plane safety; source operation rows are not reconstructed.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_configs
objects.redacted_explanation: Immutable configuration versions contain only closed scalar policy and redacted identity/version references; provider and security material is never restored.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_dependency_health
objects.redacted_explanation: Observed dependency health and immutable-version evidence are target-local control facts and are referenced without restoring stale observations.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_events
objects.redacted_explanation: Events are an append-only redacted diagnostic projection with closed detail fields; they never restore or replace owner task, operation or lifecycle authority.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_evidence
objects.redacted_explanation: Evidence metadata remains a typed, encrypted control reference; neither payload bytes nor provider storage references are restored as business data.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_evidence_chunks
objects.redacted_explanation: Chunk framing and integrity metadata is meaningful only with its evidence record and is referenced for verification, never replayed into a target.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_external_actions
objects.redacted_explanation: External-action rows preserve exact immutable non-secret request bytes, deterministic keys and provider observation hashes; replayable credentials and provider execution remain external.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_installation_state
objects.redacted_explanation: Installation identity and first-enabled history are referenced for monitoring and matrix transitions; source rows are never restored.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_job_observations
objects.redacted_explanation: Current Job generation, relay cursor, progress age and command slot are installation-local execution facts; B-owned message wire and Job execution are not restored or defined by D.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_log_chunks
objects.redacted_explanation: Only redacted log indexes and evidence references are retained for diagnostics; workload logs are not restored or resumed.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_metadata_reservations
objects.redacted_explanation: Only schema metadata is recorded. Target-local monotonic capacity reservations are not copied from a backup and must never be reset by ordinary startup or statistics refresh. Any reconciliation requires a quiesced measured target baseline.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_operations
objects.redacted_explanation: Operation rows are the target-local idempotency and orchestration ledger; actor scope, hashes and typed result references are retained without replaying mutations.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_preflights
objects.redacted_explanation: Preflight rows retain closed orchestration state and evidence references only; check bodies and restore-target content remain with their implementing owners.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_promotions
objects.redacted_explanation: Promotion records are installation-local baseline CAS facts containing typed resource and immutable evidence hashes; current health is always derived and no provider, runner or signing payload is copied.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_provider_capabilities
objects.redacted_explanation: Capability probes are bound to an exact provider identity and reference version; target capability state must be observed again rather than restored.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_prune_items
objects.redacted_explanation: Prune items freeze typed object-version or catalog-tombstone identities and D-owned lifecycle state without storing provider locators, credentials or catalog payload bytes.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_prune_runs
objects.redacted_explanation: Prune runs are installation-local candidate, confirmation, idempotency and CAS ledgers; strong-auth proof material and provider deletion payloads remain with their owners.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_source_writer_check_states
objects.redacted_explanation: Writer-inventory checks retain only versioned registry hashes, domain inventory hashes, bounded difference counts and registered evidence; every target installation must observe the writers again.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_staging_resources
objects.redacted_explanation: Staging intents, resource ownership, immutable identity and cleanup lifecycle are target-local control metadata; resource bytes and source data are never restored from these rows.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_strong_auth_nonces
objects.redacted_explanation: Consumed nonce HMACs and request hashes are installation-local authentication replay records, never restored or exposed as proof material; A-owned verifier and wire contract remain pending.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_totp_credentials
objects.redacted_explanation: Only schema metadata is recorded. Encrypted TOTP seeds, password-binding hashes, consumed steps and throttle state never enter backup payloads or diagnostic evidence. A restored target must enroll its administrator independently; source enrollment is not transferable.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_backups
objects.redacted_explanation: Backup task rows are target-local orchestration and immutable artifact-reference metadata; workload capture, security material and provider implementations are not restored.

objects.name: system_image_settings
objects.redacted_explanation: Runtime image references must be checked against target policy and availability before activation.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_maintenance_locks
objects.redacted_explanation: Gate generation, fencing and bounded deadlines are installation-local coordination state and must start empty on a restored installation.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_maintenance_mutation_leases
objects.redacted_explanation: Mutation leases bind writer operation identity to a gate generation and bounded database time; they are never restored or replayed.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_maintenance_participants
objects.redacted_explanation: Participant generation, pause ACK, checkpoint and watchdog resume facts are installation-local coordination records; restored control tables must start empty.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_restore_drill_resources
objects.redacted_explanation: Restore resource intents, owner HMACs and cleanup evidence are target-local control records; B-owned target resources and bytes are not restored or defined by D.

objects.name: system_backup_v2_restore_drills
objects.redacted_explanation: Drill rows keep only D-owned task state plus typed source, target-config hash and evidence references; B-owned restore inventory is not copied into the task row.

objects.name: user_quotas
objects.redacted_explanation: Quota policy is restored after user mapping and target capacity validation; it does not grant resources beyond the target installation limits.

objects.name: users
objects.redacted_explanation: Users are restored through immutable identity mapping and role allowlists; password hashes and external authentication material are redacted from evidence and never exposed in diagnostics.
